artifacts.summary: Eleven-phase plan for the frame-class Galois-closure layer, three dependency waves, two phases optional.

memory_candidates.content: When planning from a research report that says 'this lemma must be written' or 'add this new declaration', grep the live tree for the proposed name and for its proof route's helper lemmas BEFORE writing the phase. In the BimodalLogic Galois-closure planning, two of the research report's nine phase anchors were already in the tree: the proposed 12-line 'nextTopThm' was verbatim the existing Theorems/DiscreteUnfolding.lean succIndicator (same serial_future + prior_UZ + guardMono route), and the proposed 'nextTop' abbreviation duplicated both Formula.next Formula.top at the Syntax layer and two existing Metalogic-local copies. Following the report verbatim would have added duplicates to a formalization tree where duplicate spellings of the same formula are a known recurring defect. The correction is cheap at plan time (generalize in place; reuse the Syntax-level spelling) and expensive at implement time. Research reports that probe constructions with lean_run_code in a scratch buffer are especially prone to this: a snippet compiles standalone precisely because it does not import the module that already defines the symbol.
